Maria: Quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8127 needs a 2nd approver before 19:00 PT cutoff. I flipped the merge gate to hold.
Jay: On it, give me 15. :eyes: 
Sasha: I can take a look after stand, what's the risk?
Maria: Short summary: KV cache mem fix, unit tests ✅, staging smoke ✅, e2e flaky on tf-log ingest (non-deterministic)
Todd: pinging @Oliver for final LGTM — he reviewed perf earlier
Oliver: Looking now, commenting on one minor race in kv_warmup.go
Oliver: ...actually small nit, tests look good, approving if we add a comment and a short TODO for follow-up
Maria: I can add the TODO. Do we want to proceed if e2e stays flaky?
Jay: If e2e is flaky and unchanged, I'm okay to proceed with a rollback guard in case we see regressions. Suggest enabling auto-fallback and a short metric alert.
Maria: Agreed. Plan: merge after 2nd LGTM, set release flag auto-fallback=true, and deploy canary to 10% first.
Maria: Here's the command I'll run:
```
/release set-flag --name auto-fallback --value true --env prod
/release canary --percent 10 --pr 8127
```
deploy-bot: Release flag auto-fallback=true set by Maria at 2026-03-17T02:03:15Z — canary scheduled (10%).
Jay: Thanks. @Oliver can you drop your LGTM when ready?
Oliver: LGTM :thumbsup: — added TODO comment.
Sasha: Quick note — monitor kv_cache_miss_rate and mem.rss 5m p90. I'll watch dashboards.
Todd: I'll take ownership of rollback window (first 30m). If anything weird, I will trigger rollback.
Maria: Awesome. Merging in 2m. Thanks all. :rocket:
